About St. Rita’s Retreat

A grounded place for reflection, connection, and meaningful time together.

Location

Our Setting

St. Rita’s is located in Southern Oregon, a region known for its natural beauty, rivers, mountains, and cultural destinations. Guests often balance time on the grounds with time exploring nearby landscapes, historic towns, or outdoor activities.

Whether gathering for reflection, shared learning, or renewal, groups may choose to incorporate hiking, river excursions, regional arts, or seasonal events into their stay.

The retreat serves as a steady home base — a place to gather, return, and reconnect.

Approach

Retreat Styles & Planning

St. Rita’s supports a range of retreat styles — from contemplative stays to activity-centered gatherings.

Groups often design schedules that combine time on the grounds with off-site experiences throughout Southern Oregon. Stays are arranged through inquiry to ensure availability and alignment with the purpose and rhythm of each gathering.

This approach allows us to support both reflective and activity-based retreats while maintaining a respectful and thoughtful shared environment.

Quick Questions

A Few Common Answers before you reach out

FAQ's

FAQs

✖
What is your group cancellation policy?
➤
Cancellation more than 90 days before the event entitles you to a 50% refund of your deposit. Cancellation within 90 days forfeits the deposit.
How many guests can the Center accommodate?
➤
Capacity depends on the event type. Maximum overnight and commuter limits will be specified in your contract.
What are check-in and check-out times?
➤
Check-in and check-out times are confirmed during scheduling. Please include early arrival or late departure requests in your inquiry.
